newsitem.title: USA: Atria files registration for six mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Atria files registration for six mln shrs.

text.p: Atria Communities Inc said Thursday it had filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of six million common shares.
It said all the shares will be sold by the company and that underwriters will be granted an over-allotment option for an additional 15 percent of the shares to be offered.
The offering is to be lead managed by Alex. Brown, with J.C. Bradford & Co. and Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette as co-managers.
Atria said it expects to make the offering later this month.
The company has 16.5 million common shares outstanding.

The Louisville, Kentucky-based company provides of assisted and independent living services for the elderly. At May 31, it operated 40 communities in 17 states. The company said it has 35 additional communities under development.
A company statement said net proceeds from the offering will finance the development and acquisition of assisted living communities and for general corporate purposes.
